files.desc: Section layouts (b-*) used by the 38 page blocks. Container-query responsive.
Buttons, cards, forms, tabs, badges, overlays, nav, data, loaders, backgrounds.
60+ uv-fx-* effect mixins: glitch, chrome, holo, neon, CRT, sticker, stamp, jelly…
All element designs (buttons, cards, inputs, switches, tabs, nav, badges, alerts, modals, spinners, progress, headings, backgrounds) in one file.
UV namespace, module registry, UV.init, UV.theme, UV.skin. Required.
toast, modal, ⌘K palette, confetti, synthesized sounds, copy.
Tabs with sliding indicator, OTP, range, file drop.
Canvas + pointer effects: matrix, starfield, particles, snow, cursor trail/blob, sparkles, magnet, gravity, fireworks.
countUp, typewriter, scramble, reveal, tilt, magnetic, spotlight, ripple, parallax, ring.
Filmic, blurred procedural waterfall background (WebGL, low-res, pauses off-screen).
Every element design and kit as data (names, descriptions, Python/C++ approximations).
